# Dixi screen recordings for the pitch video

Recorded 2026-10-11 from the real app (`pnpm build && pnpm start`, production server, so there is no dev overlay). Light mode, viewport 1920x1080 at DPR 1, headless Chrome.
Capture method: CDP screencast at JPEG q92 with real frame timestamps, converted to MP4 (H.264, yuv420p tv-range, 30 fps CFR, CRF 16).
A cursor dot (22 px, semi-transparent dark, white rim) and a blue click ripple are injected because headless video has no cursor. Over the dark car banners the dot reads as a white ring.

**Data:** fictional demo set `Demo/02-data/demo-pipeline.json`, built by `Demo/02-data/build-demo-pipeline.mjs`. It contains no BMW data and no real quotes. The banner therefore says **"Example data"** (origin `example`), not "BMW hackathon data". No fallback banner appears for China: CN has 1,840 comments in the demo set.
Signals (competitors & trends) come from the app's tracked `market-signals.ts`, which was not changed.

Timestamps below are seconds from the start of each clip.

---

## rec-01-l1.mp4 · 15.3 s · L1: market, series, principles
| s | what happens |
|---|---|
| 0.0 | `/dashboard/new` "Which market are you deciding for?" with the globe (Europe/China/Japan pins). Cursor drifts over the globe |
| 3.1 | **China** selected (market card click; the globe turns China red and rotates). "Continue to China →" appears |
| 6.3 | Series picker "CHINA · STEP 2 OF 3 · Which car are you planning?". 5 Series card: *1,840 comments · 14 requests · 9 signals* (1 and 7 Series: "No comments here yet") |
| ~8.5 | Click "Start analysis" on **5 Series** |
| 9.2 | Pipeline banner "G60 · **5 Series · China** · business sedan, the volume driver · 1,840 customer comments · 13 feature requests · 9 competitors & trends". AI analysis card: **BMW PRINCIPLES: "Retrieving the fundamentals and principles for the 5 Series (3)"** ✓, then market evidence and building the list tick through |
| 14.0 | Analysis done, the request list appears |

Note: the pipeline has no separate "principles banner". L1 shows up here as the first analysis step, and in full as "Principles P1–P3" in the profile (rec-04 at 16 s).

## rec-02-l2-list.mp4 · 17.3 s · L2: scored list, fridge detail
| s | what happens |
|---|---|
| 0.0 | Stepper at "2 Your decisions". Competitors & trends · China: *Connected cars, uneven OTA payoff · Hidden door handles banned · Long-wheelbase rear comfort (Mercedes E-Class L) · Plug-in hybrids and EREVs hold* |
| 3.8 | Smooth scroll to "Feature requests · 13", then down the list and back up |
| 11.8 | **Detail panel opens: "Rear-seat refrigerator"** (G60-D01 · Interior) |
| 13.9 | Quotes, markets and channels visible. Holds until 17.3 |

Visible CN list (rank · title · CN mentions · score · flames): 1 **Rear-seat refrigerator** 214 · 75 🔥🔥🔥 · 2 Extended rear legroom (long wheelbase) 186 · 73 · 3 Quiet cabin / acoustic glass 118 · 68 · 4 Rear entertainment screen 100 · 67 · 5 Ambient lighting 96 · 66 · 6 Rear seat massage 81 · 64 · 7 Easier, more reliable charging 18 · 64 (badges "Megawatt charging in China", "NIO ET5 / ET7 / ET9") · 8 Head-up display 28 · 53 · 9 **Smaller footprint for city parking** 58 · 52 · 10 Ventilated front seats 22 · 50 · 11 Wireless CarPlay stability 7 · 38 · 12 Sharper steering / driver focus 12 · 35 · 13 Larger cargo / trunk 9 · 32.
Fridge panel: "Rear passengers want a cooled compartment for drinks between the rear seats." · Dixi score **75** (Demand 100 · Market backing 0 · Principle fit 100) · 208 wish it / 24 hard to use / 10 defect · Customers say: *"I sit in the back on most trips; a small fridge for water is expected at this price."* / *"The competitor sedan my partner drives has a cooled box in the rear armrest."* / *"On the airport run my guests ask for a cold drink and we have nowhere to keep one."* · Markets CN 214, Other 11, US 9, EU 6, JP 2 · Channels Owner survey 82, Social listening 63, Dealer reports 58, Customer care 39 · Taxonomy "Interior › Rear seats › Cooled storage".

## rec-03-l2-decide.mp4 · 16.6 s · human gate: keep and reject with a reason
| s | what happens |
|---|---|
| 2.4 | **Keep** on Rear-seat refrigerator, which shows "✓ Kept" |
| ~5.3 | Reject (✕) on Smaller footprint for city parking (#9) |
| 5.9 | **Reject dialog**: "REJECT REQUEST · Why are you rejecting “Smaller footprint for city parking”?" · "Recorded as Marco Rossi · Product manager · 5 Series · now", with preset chips |
| 6.4–9.9 | Typed into "Explain in your words (required)": **"Contradicts L1: rear space is core for China"** |
| 12.2 | "Reject and save reason" clicked. The row is struck through: *"Why: Contradicts L1: rear space is core for China — Marco Rossi, 11 Oct 2026, 03:5x"* |
| 12.5–16.6 | Cursor moves to the **Decisions** log: "Rejected · Smaller footprint for city parking · “Contradicts L1: rear space is core for China” · Marco Rossi (Product manager · 5 Series)" above "Kept · Rear-seat refrigerator". Footer: "1 kept · 1 rejected · 11 open" |

## rec-04-l3-profiles.mp4 · 18.8 s · L3: build profiles and the "why"
| s | what happens |
|---|---|
| 0–3.3 | Keeps 3 more (the app needs at least 3): Extended rear legroom, Quiet cabin / acoustic glass, Rear entertainment screen → "4 kept · 1 rejected" |
| 6.3 | **Build profiles** clicked ("Building profiles from your 4 kept requests") |
| 7.6 | Generation dashboard "5 Series · China · 3 profiles · 4 kept · 1 rejected". Three cards: **A Comfort & craft 91 (Best fit)** · B Tech-forward 89 · C Fix the basics 76. Cursor hovers C → B → A |
| 13.1 | Opens **Comfort & craft**: cover "BMW 5 · PROFILE A · COMFORT & CRAFT", profile at a glance (L1 100 · L2 84 · L3 not run · total 91) |
| 16.0 | Scrolls to **WHY THIS PROFILE**: 1 "Covers 518 customer mentions, 84% of everything you kept." 2 "3 of 3 requirements match the 5 Series's focus on Digital and Interior (BMW principles)." 3 "Takes your top priorities #1, #2, #3." 4 "Leans on Interior." 5 "Leaves out Rear entertainment screen." Next to it: **PRINCIPLES** P1 "Business sedan first: comfort and quiet on long trips." · P2 "Every powertrain (ICE, PHEV, BEV) keeps the same core experience." · P3 "Technology must be easy to use without the manual." Below: DECISION TRAIL "REJECTED Smaller footprint for city parking · “Contradicts L1: rear space is core for China”" |

Comfort & craft requests: Rear-seat refrigerator #1 · Extended rear legroom (long wheelbase) #2 · Quiet cabin / acoustic glass #3.

## rec-05-l3-social.mp4 · 13.3 s · L3: social test and recommendation
| s | what happens |
|---|---|
| 1.6 | Analytics tab: "Test the profiles on social media" |
| 4.0 | "Launch test (simulated)" clicked. "Simulated campaign: no real posts were made." |
| 4.9 | **"TRACKING BEST · SOCIAL SCORE · Comfort & craft leads by 3 points"** · "Final scores already include this test at 8% weight." Social scores: Comfort & craft 60 · Tech-forward 55 · Fix the basics 57 |
| ~6 | Posts (AI-generated images, labelled): "Arrive as rested as you left." (Comfort & craft, *Best*) · "The road ahead, upgraded." · "Every drive starts calm." |
| 7.9 | Engagement rate per day: curves for 14 days |
| 11.9 | Back to Profiles, re-ranked with the social score: **Comfort & craft 89 (Best fit)** · Tech-forward 86 · Fix the basics 75 |

The social test is simulated and seeded by the generation ID, so a re-take can produce a different social leader. The script retries until Comfort & craft leads (`WANT_LEADER`).

## rec-06-weights.mp4 · 20.2 s · scoring weights in plain language
| s | what happens |
|---|---|
| 0.0 | `/dashboard/settings` "Scoring and decision memory", with "Tell Dixi in your words" and the Live example |
| 2.0–2.8 | Drags the **Demand** slider (Base score card) from raw 0.60 to 0.70. The share shown moves from 60% to 64% |
| 4.8–9.9 | Types **"Trust customer feedback more than social media for the 5 Series"**, then clicks "Suggest settings" ("Thinking…") |
| 11.4 | **Cut**: the live AI took 6.3 s; the clip keeps 1.5 s of "Thinking…" and jumps |
| 11.8 | Proposal: **"PROPOSAL · AI (GPT-6-LUNA)"**: "Customer feedback will count more than social-media and market signals. Settings apply to all series and markets, not only the 5 Series." Table: Demand weight 70% → **80%**, Market backing weight 25% → **15%** |
| 17.0 | **Apply** clicked. CHANGE LOG: "“Trust customer feedback more than social media for the 5 Series” · Marco Rossi (Product manager · 5 Series) · 11 Oct 2026 · AI gpt-6-luna · 2 changes". Sliders now Demand 73% / Market backing 14% / Principle fit 14% |

This was a live OpenAI call (key read server-side from `../.env`), not the rules fallback.

## rec-07-us-profiles.mp4 · 11.6 s · USA: the drivers' car
| s | what happens |
|---|---|
| 0.0 | `/dashboard/us/5-series` list (analysis skipped before recording): "5 Series · USA · 2,960 customer comments · 14 feature requests · 14 competitors & trends". Top rows: 1 **Sharper steering / driver focus** 342 · 66 · 2 Wireless CarPlay stability 140 · 66 · 3 Head-up display 132 · 65 · 4 Ventilated front seats 100 · 62 · then Easier, more reliable charging, Towing hitch, Larger cargo / trunk … rear-comfort requests sit at the bottom (fridge 9, massage 6, smaller footprint 4) |
| 1.7 | Keeps the top request **Sharper steering / driver focus**, then CarPlay, Head-up display, Ventilated front seats |
| 5.3 | 4 kept; the list scrolls down to the "Build profiles" bar |
| 7.9 | Build profiles |
| 9.1 | US profiles: **A Tech-forward 89 (Best fit)**: Sharper steering / driver focus #1, Wireless CarPlay stability #2, Head-up display #3 · B Fix the basics 86 · C Comfort & craft 86 |

---

## Stills (`stills/`, 1920x1080 PNG)
| file | content |
|---|---|
| cn-list.png | CN 5 Series pipeline: banner, signals, top of the scored list, empty Decisions |
| cn-fridge-detail.png | Rear-seat refrigerator panel with score, quotes, markets, channels |
| cn-reject-dialog.png | Reject dialog with the typed reason |
| decision-log.png | Struck-through rejected row with "Why:", plus the Decisions log (reject + keep) |
| cn-profiles.png | Three CN profiles, Comfort & craft "Best fit" 91 |
| cn-social.png, cn-profiles-after-social.png | Analytics after the test: "Comfort & craft leads by 3 points" (extra) |
| us-profiles.png | Three US profiles, Tech-forward "Best fit" 89 |
| weights.png | AI proposal table in Settings |
| weights-logged.png | Settings after Apply, with the change-log entry (extra) |

## Re-recording
Everything is in `_tools/` (`pnpm install` there; it uses the system Chrome via Playwright 1.49.1):
1. `cp ../../02-data/demo-pipeline.json ../../../web/data-local/pipeline.json`, then `cd web && pnpm build && pnpm start`.
2. `WANT_LEADER="Comfort & craft" node take-cn.mjs` (rec-01…05, about 90 s; exit code 3 means the social leader differed, so run it again), `node take-weights.mjs` (rec-06), `node take-us.mjs` (rec-07). Each take clears all `dixi:*` localStorage first.
3. `node reencode.mjs` rebuilds every MP4 from the saved frames in `_frames/` (about 800 MB; delete it if you don't need re-encodes).
4. Restore the real data: `cp ../../02-data/backup/pipeline.real.json ../../../web/data-local/pipeline.json && cmp …`, then `pnpm build` again.
`_tools/sim.ts` (`npx tsx sim.ts`) checks the demo data offline against the app's own scoring and profile logic.
